svg.title: Sachin's job search system blueprint — profile, hard filters, soft scoring

g.text: Sachin Kumar Anumula — Job Search Blueprint
No comp listed = flag not disqualify
Reposted 30+ days, vague JD, no team info
Healthcare, fintech, logistics, or large-scale platform — industries where Sachin has direct proven experience
Connection bridge — for any approved job
Check LinkedIn CSV → 1st degree = draft message → 2nd degree = intro ask → none = strong application only
